## How to buy

- Email the per-item address above (arrives in Tyler's inbox) with your
  name and a pickup time.
- Payment: cash or Venmo at handover. No shipping, no checks, no couriers.
- Pickup: Bella Vista, NWA — or the Rogers PD / Bentonville PD
  safe-exchange zones. Heavy items: bring a friend and a truck/SUV;
  Tyler helps load.
- All listings removed promptly once sold. This file and the sitemap are
  kept current; a sold item will not appear here.
